scope: bounded feasibility screening; no GRU or SLT
data: all 200 train sequences; deterministic existing 180/20 sequence split; test untouched
events: GT selects training sample locations only; observations and deployment have no GT
coverage: eight consecutive warmup frames at cyclically assigned 4/6/8, starting from baseline snapshot
continuation: fixed8 for initial teachers; frozen current event policy for aggregated teachers
teacher: eight-frame visible IoU of each scale-only first action; subsequent seven actions from continuation controller
model: 32 input, two 64-wide ReLU layers, two regressed advantages against action 8; default action 8
decision: intervene iff maximum predicted advantage > margin; ties retain 8
selection: maximum equal-sequence uniform internal-dev teacher utility over epoch and margin; ties prefer fewer interventions, then earlier epoch
loss: mean squared error of two eight-frame advantages

arms.uniform: coverage cache, uniform samples only, 2560 updates
arms.event: same cache; half uniform and half event draws, 2560 updates
arms.event_continue: continue event for 2560 updates, retain initial checkpoint as candidate
arms.aggregate: same event initialization; half previous event-balanced pool and half on-policy event-balanced pool, 2560 additional updates

aggregation_selection: same fixed initial-cache uniform dev states for all continuation arms; aggregate additionally reports on-policy dev diagnostics
full_validation: all 90 official val sequences for each internally selected arm; fixed8 mandatory reference
confounding_note: new regression gate differs from preceding soft-teacher pilot; claims compare matched arms in this protocol only
advance_rule: only consider GRU/SLT after complete-val deployed controller beats fixed8; final method still requires seeds0/1/2 and planned gate
